scope: Evidence needed to label updated manipulation evaluation tables; no simulator execution

source_findings.finding: Generator selects houses from unsorted os.listdir(scene_dir); filename UUID suffix is not house identity; original same-stem simulator JSON preserves the full scene.

LeRobot exporter emits episode_index,filename,cameras but omits the house path. Its published code obtains camera metadata from the first input episode and reuses it; exported camera rows alone are not authoritative evidence of per-episode views.
Replay/translation can replace camera settings and writes same-episode -tr.json. Prefer the JSON that actually produced the exported frames when auditing full conditions.

mapping_scope: All20000training episodes; include2015validation and2011test episodes if selecting held-out episodes from those splits. Missing/ambiguous rows remain unresolved; no inference from seed/suffix.
selected_json_requirement: Original exact-export-input scene JSON for selected held-out episodes, including translated/replayed configs where applicable; optional corresponding house asset hashes to bind versions. No weights/videos/full dataset needed.
eval_table_labels_until_verified: Official DOM benchmark: train-house overlap unverified
Seen-house held-out: only after mapping; other distribution axes separately audited
Velocity-only OOD: only after paired-scene config diff/initial-state/actual-velocity checks
paired_velocity_protocol: Freeze all non-target-velocity conditions and use matched seeds/initialization across pair/model; whitelist only the target velocity field in config diffs; record actual realized velocities and declare OOD thresholds against training support. MG alone is not verification.
planning_gap: Task/speed and duplicate-group selection preserved held-out episodes, but house mapping and scene-controlled IID/velocity-OOD protocol were not validated before launching the20k campaign; earlier explicit warnings were not enforced as experiment launch prerequisites.
